note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: 1:1 crop is smeared with low detail (detail_gain 5.9); horizontal streak field reads as wood boards rather than the original stone courses.
flags.fix: Weaken the hstreak field and restore stone-like grain/edge detail at 1:1; keep the horizontal course lines but drop the wood-plank look.

flags.problem: Flat letter strokes are thickened, outline edges are jagged with dark notches at lower-right of the D, and background bands are posterised.
flags.fix: Re-trace or use nearest-neighbour 8x with edge-aware smoothing so stroke width and silhouette match the 16px original; remove dark notch artifacts.

flags.problem: Gauge decal loses soft rim glow and tick detail at 1:1; plane fill posterises into blocky camouflage blobs with wobbly edges.
flags.fix: Reduce the 8x smoothing on flat art; keep antialiased edges and the original rim glow and tick marks so the decal design stays exact.
